# QuizWiz

> QuizWiz offers online practice quizzes and quiz championship programs for students in India.

## About QuizWiz

- [About QuizWiz](https://quizwiz.co.in/about): Mission, competition divisions, and program information.
- [Online quizzes](https://quizwiz.co.in/quizzes): Quiz categories and practice activities.
- [Daily quiz](https://quizwiz.co.in/daily-quiz): Daily quiz information.
- [Brain puzzles](https://quizwiz.co.in/puzzles): Logic and reasoning puzzles.
- [Prizes and rewards](https://quizwiz.co.in/rewards): Published competition prizes and rewards.

## Participation

- [Student enrollment](https://quizwiz.co.in/enroll): Championship enrollment details.
- [Campus ambassador program](https://quizwiz.co.in/ambassador): Ambassador program details and application.
- [Contact QuizWiz](https://quizwiz.co.in/contact): Support and contact information.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://quizwiz.co.in/privacy-policy)
- [DPDP compliance](https://quizwiz.co.in/dpdp)
- [Terms and conditions](https://quizwiz.co.in/terms)
- [Refund policy](https://quizwiz.co.in/refund-policy)
